*
* Title: OPQALLUN
* Author: J.L. Gibson
* Date Written: 14 June 1994
* Oracle Vers. Orig.: 7.0
*
* Revision History:
*
* Modified By Modified Date Version Description of changes
* ---------------------------------------------------------------
* J.L. Gibson 06/14/94 1.0 Initial Version
* J.L. Gibson 14 Jun 94 2.0 Added a join of tables
* pick_slip_products and
* order_items by item_no
* as per AR #59015.
* Also, corrected the
* counting of records for
* Alo Qty as per
* AR #63579.
* Linh Tran 03/10/95 2.1 Added online help
*
* Abstract:
*
* This forms allows the user to determine the order number,
* pick slip id, order priority, product status, product quantities,
* and customer from entering the product type and blood type.
*
* Modules Referenced:
*
* See document ....
*
* Inputs:
* Product Type - The different product groupings.
* Blood Type - ABORH
* Allocated Flag - Selects the allocated products.
* Packed Flag - Select the packed products.
*
* Outputs:
* Displaying the information for the user.
*
* Error Conditions:
* Validation checks on entered information and navigation
* checks for illegal keys entered.
*
* Assumptions and Limitations:
* Validation tables must be populated.
*
* Functional Descriptions:
* This screen begins with entering a valid product type
* and valid blood type. There are two fields for
* selecting a product status. The first status field is
* allocated and the second is packed. If the both fields
* are left blank, then all product statuses are selected.
* Once these fields are completed, the query is performed
* and the information is displayed accordingly.
*
***************************************************************************

Trigger.Name: VALIDATE_FIELD
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_product_type VARCHAR2(10);
 temp_product_desc VARCHAR2(50);
 chp_sysdate DATE;
begin
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 exception
 when others then 
 tackle_error('TimeZone Convert');
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 -- 
 :GLOBAL.null_value := 'FALSE';
 nullchk;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.product_type is null
 then
 :GLOBAL.null_value := 'TRUE';
 end if;
 begin
 select product_type,product_type_desc
 into temp_product_type, temp_product_desc
 from vserv_product_types
 where product_type = :ctrl_blk_1.product_type
 and CHP_SYSDATE between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,CHP_SYSDATE+365);
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 Null;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_product_type is not Null
 then
 if :s_product_desc is null
 then
 :s_product_desc := temp_product_desc;
 end if;
 NEXT_ITEM;
 else
 show_error_dist('0322');
 /* Invalid Product Type */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

declare
 temp_desc VARCHAR2(20);
 temp_type VARCHAR2(4);
begin
 :GLOBAL.null_value := 'FALSE';
 nullchk;
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_abo_desc is null
 then
 :GLOBAL.null_value := 'TRUE';
 end if;
 temp_desc := :ctrl_blk_1.s_abo_desc;
 temp_type := :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type;
 parse_abo('M',temp_type,temp_desc);
 if temp_type is not null then
 begin
---
--- modified for both the schemes to coexists
---
/****HCL not required *******
 select code,code_desc
 into :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type, :ctrl_blk_1.s_abo_desc
 from vserv_abo_type
 where code = temp_type
 and SYSDATE between eff_date
 and nvl(term_date,SYSDATE+365);
HCL***/
 SELECT abo_code, abo_desc
 INTO :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type, :ctrl_blk_1.s_abo_desc
 FROM vserv_abo
 WHERE abo_code = temp_type AND
 rownum < 2 AND
 identifier_code = 'RG'
 ORDER BY abo_code;

 NEXT_ITEM;
 exception
 when NO_DATA_FOUND
 then
 show_error_dist('0300');
 /* Invalid Blood Type */
 check_package_failure;
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 else
 show_error_dist('0300');
 /* Invalid Blood Type */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
end;

Trigger.Name: KEY-NXTBLK
Trigger.TriggerText:
declare
 temp_count number;
 temp_flag VARCHAR2(10);
begin
 null_value(temp_flag);
 if temp_flag = 'TRUE'
 then
 show_error_dist('0204');
 check_package_failure;
 else
 if :system.cursor_field = 'CTRL_BLK_1.PRODUCT_TYPE'
 or :system.cursor_field = 'CTRL_BLK_1.S_ABO_DESC'
 or (:system.cursor_field = 'CTRL_BLK_1.S_ALLOC'
 and :system.cursor_value is not null)
 then
 execute_trigger('KEY-NEXT-ITEM');
 else
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_pack = 'X'
 then
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_pack_status := 'PK';
 end if;
 go_block('pick_slip');
 begin
 if :ctrl_blk_1.s_all_status is null
 and :ctrl_blk_1.s_pack_status is null
 then
 :GLOBAL.ISNULL := 'TRUE';
 show_error_dist('0240');
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 GO_ITEM('s_alloc');
 else
 :GLOBAL.ISNULL := 'FALSE';
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from pick_slips ps, pick_slip_products psp
 where ps.pick_slip_id = psp.pick_slip_id
 and psp.product_type = :ctrl_blk_1.product_type
 and psp.blood_type IN ( SELECT distinct abo_label 
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE (tested_abo_code,abo_only) IN
 ( SELECT tested_abo_code ,abo_only
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE abo_label = :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type 
 and rownum < 2 )) 
-- HCL = :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type
 and (psp.product_status like :ctrl_blk_1.s_all_status
 or psp.product_status like :ctrl_blk_1.s_pack_status)
 and psp.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id
 and ps.chapter_id = :GLOBAL.chapter_id;
 /*MODIFIED BY HCL CONSULTING*/
 end if;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 if temp_count != 0
 then
 main_query;
 elsif :GLOBAL.ISNULL = 'FALSE'
 then
 go_block('ctrl_blk_1');
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_alloc := '';
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_all_status := '';
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_pack := '';
 :ctrl_blk_1.s_pack_status := '';
 show_error_dist('2200');
 /* No Products Selected */
 check_package_failure;
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
end;

ProgramUnit.Name: MAIN_QUERY
ProgramUnit.ProgramUnitText:
procedure main_query is
 temp_count number(2);
 temp_order_no VARCHAR2(14) := '%%%';
 dup_rec_flag VARCHAR2(5) := 'FALSE';
 chp_sysdate DATE;
 cursor c1(pl_chp_sysdate IN DATE) is
---
--- modified for both the schemes to coexists
---
 select distinct o.order_no ord_no, ps.pick_slip_id ps_id,
 voc.class_desc cls, vos.code_desc stat,
 oi.required_qty req, c.name cname
 from pick_slip_products psp, pick_slips ps, order_items oi,
 orders o, customers c, vserv_order_classes voc,
 vserv_order_status vos
 where psp.product_type = :ctrl_blk_1.product_type
---HCL and psp.blood_type = :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type
--Following subquery added to get all possible blood types from base blood types
 AND psp.blood_type IN ( SELECT distinct abo_label 
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE (tested_abo_code,abo_only) IN
 ( SELECT tested_abo_code ,abo_only
 FROM valid_abo_values
 WHERE abo_label = :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type 
 and rownum < 2 )) 
 and (psp.product_status like :ctrl_blk_1.s_all_status
 or psp.product_status like :ctrl_blk_1.s_pack_status)
 and psp.chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id
 and psp.pick_slip_id = ps.pick_slip_id
 and psp.chapter_id = ps.chapter_id
 and ps.order_no = oi.order_no
 and psp.item_no = oi.item_no
 and ps.chapter_id = oi.chapter_id
 and oi.order_no = o.order_no
 and oi.chapter_id = o.chapter_id
 and o.customer_id = c.customer_id
 and o.chapter_id = c.chapter_id
 and o.order_class = voc.order_class
 and o.chapter_id = voc.chapter_id
 and PL_CHP_SYSDATE between voc.eff_date
 and nvl(voc.term_date,PL_CHP_SYSDATE+365)
 and psp.product_status = vos.code
 and PL_CHP_SYSDATE between vos.eff_date
 and nvl(vos.term_date,PL_CHP_SYSDATE+365);
begin
 -- IM:5412; AV; 05/08/2011
 begin
 if is_timezone_enabled then
 Lifetrack_timezone_convert.get_local_time(:global.chapter_id,sysdate,chp_sysdate);
 else
 chp_sysdate := sysdate;
 end if; 
 exception
 when others then 
 tackle_error('TimeZone Convert');
 check_package_failure;
 end; 
 -- 
 for c1_rec in c1(chp_sysdate)
 loop
 if temp_order_no != c1_rec.ord_no
 then
 temp_order_no := c1_rec.ord_no;
 :pick_slip.order_no := c1_rec.ord_no;
 dup_rec_flag := 'FALSE';
 else
 :pick_slip.order_no := '';
 dup_rec_flag := 'TRUE';
 end if;
 :pick_slip.pick_slip_id := c1_rec.ps_id;
 if dup_rec_flag != 'TRUE'
 then
 :pick_slip.order_class := c1_rec.cls;
 :pick_slip.s_ord_sts := c1_rec.stat;
 :pick_slip.required_qty := c1_rec.req;
 :pick_slip.s_cust_desc := c1_rec.cname;
 else
 :pick_slip.order_class := '';
 :pick_slip.s_ord_sts := '';
 :pick_slip.required_qty := '';
 :pick_slip.s_cust_desc := '';
 end if;
 begin
 select count(*) into temp_count
 from pick_slip_products
 where pick_slip_id = c1_rec.ps_id
 and product_type = :ctrl_blk_1.product_type
 and blood_type = :ctrl_blk_1.blood_type
 and (product_status like :ctrl_blk_1.s_all_status
 or product_status like :ctrl_blk_1.s_pack_status)
 and chapter_id = :ctrl_blk_1.s_chapter_id;
 exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
 end;
 :pick_slip.allocated_qty := temp_count;
 down;
 end loop;
 clear_record;
 go_record('1');
exception
 when OTHERS
 then
 handle_error;
 check_package_failure;
end;

 or :system.cursor_field = 'CTRL_BLK_1.S_ABO_DESC')
 then

 else

 end if;
end;
